title: Hired 3 marketing agencies in 2 years — all terrible. What am I doing wrong?

posts.caption_note: Open with vulnerability: 'I've fired 3 agencies in 24 months. Here's what I finally realized...' Lead with the problem, hint at the solution.
posts.cross_promote: Link to X thread in comments; direct readers to follow for daily insights
posts.engagement_strategy: Respond to first 20 comments within 1 hour; ask clarifying questions to drive conversation

posts.caption_note: 5-tweet thread breaking down: 1) Red flags you missed, 2) Wrong questions you asked, 3) What to look for instead, 4) How to audit current partnerships, 5) The one metric that matters
posts.cross_promote: Quote tweet your LinkedIn post; tag agencies/marketing communities
posts.engagement_strategy: Monitor replies every 30 mins for 2 hours; engage with quote tweets; retweet thoughtful replies

posts.caption_note: Hot contrarian take: 'Most agencies aren't bad—your brief is. If you can't explain your business in 60 seconds, neither can they.' Provoke discussion.
posts.cross_promote: Reference the thread from Day 2; drive engagement by asking 'Am I wrong?'
posts.engagement_strategy: Respond to every reply within 30 mins; look for ratio opportunities; engage with disagreements thoughtfully

posts.engagement_strategy: Pin this post for 24 hours; respond within 1 hour; bookmark comments with specific advice to build social proof

posts.caption_note: 90-second video: Sit-down format. 'Here's the exact conversation I should've had with agency #1.' Demonstrate the audit framework.
posts.cross_promote: Tease the poll below; link to carousel from Day 4
posts.engagement_strategy: Respond to all video comments; encourage shares; tag connections who've hired agencies

posts.caption_note: 4-option poll: 'What's your biggest agency hiring mistake?' Options: Bad chemistry, Wrong deliverables, No strategy, Hidden costs. Tie to larger thread.
posts.cross_promote: Share results back to LinkedIn on Day 7; reference in hot take
posts.engagement_strategy: Live-tweet poll results as they come in; retweet top replies; use data for Monday insight post

posts.caption_note: Sunday evening reflection: 'Poll results: X% of you hired the wrong agency for the wrong reasons. Here's how to fix it starting Monday.' Actionable close-out.
posts.cross_promote: Reference X poll data; link back to all week's content in carousel comment; invite DMs for follow-up

strategy_notes: Day 1-2: Build narrative arc on LinkedIn (vulnerability) → X (tactical breakdown)
Day 3-4: Pivot to contrarian angle + tangible framework (carousel); increase LinkedIn velocity
Day 5: Video humanizes the advice; highest engagement format—prioritize response rate
Day 6-7: Close with data-driven insights; use weekend timing to capture reflective audience
Cross-platform: LinkedIn → X for threadability; X polls → LinkedIn data posts (full circle)
Comment strategy: Respond in 1st hour, then 3x daily thereafter; depth > speed
Avoid: Hard selling before Day 7; low-engagement bait; algorithm manipulation
key_cta: Book a free 15-minute marketing audit to diagnose your agency problems—no pitch, just diagnosis.
